# Mission configuration reference

`MissionConfig` is loaded once from YAML at the boundary (launch file or CLI) and passed
explicitly to constructors. Every key is optional; a missing key keeps its default. Unknown
keys and out-of-range values are startup errors (ADR-0002).

```yaml
drop:
  align_pixel_thresh_px: 20
camera:
  f_px: 487.5
```

## `perception`

Filters applied to segmentation masks before the mission sees a detection.

Every colour needs at least one HSV range, each with 0 <= lo <= hi <= (180, 255, 255).

| Key | Default | Unit | Constraints | Description | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `perception.fill_ratio_min_circle` | 0.4 | ratio | > 0, ≤ 1 | Minimum mask fill ratio of a solid fire circle; rejects rings and arcs | legacy tuning |
| `perception.h_landing_overlap_thresh` | 0.45 | ratio | > 0, ≤ 1 | Share of a circle's box inside an H_landing box above which the circle is suppressed | legacy tuning |
| `perception.edge_clip_margin_px` | 5 | px | ≥ 0 | A contour this close to the frame border is edge-clipped; its radius is not trusted for altitude | legacy tuning |
| `perception.color_match_threshold` | 0.25 | ratio | > 0, ≤ 1 | Minimum share of mask pixels inside a colour's HSV ranges | legacy tuning |
| `perception.hsv_ranges` | red: (0, 120, 80)–(10, 255, 255) ∪ (165, 120, 80)–(180, 255, 255)<br>yellow: (18, 100, 100)–(38, 255, 255)<br>blue: (100, 130, 50)–(145, 255, 255) | HSV (OpenCV) | – | Inclusive (lo, hi) HSV ranges per colour; tune on site with tools/hsv_calibrator.py | field calibration |

## `camera`

Downward camera intrinsics.

| Key | Default | Unit | Constraints | Description | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `camera.f_px` | 500 | px | > 0 | Focal length; always override with the calibrated value | camera calibration |

## `drop`

Ball-release window and attitude gate.

Cross-field checks: altitude_min_m >= 3.05 m (rulebook floor + margin);
altitude_min_m < altitude_target_m < altitude_max_m <= 5.0 m;
tilt_max_relaxed_deg >= max_pitch_deg.

| Key | Default | Unit | Constraints | Description | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `drop.altitude_min_m` | 3.05 | m | – | Lowest altitude at which a ball may be released | rulebook §III-4 (>= 3.0 m) + 5 cm margin |
| `drop.altitude_target_m` | 3.25 | m | – | Preferred drop altitude; also the fallback vision altitude before any estimate exists | legacy tuning |
| `drop.altitude_max_m` | 4.5 | m | – | Highest drop altitude; above it the drone descends | legacy tuning |
| `drop.align_pixel_thresh_px` | 25 | px | > 0 | Max offset of the predicted impact point from the frame centre | legacy tuning |
| `drop.max_fire_diameter_ratio` | 0.55 | ratio | > 0, ≤ 1 | Largest circle diameter / frame width accepted as a fire target | legacy tuning |
| `drop.scored_world_radius_m` | 0.6 | m | > 0 | Exclusion radius around circles already hit | legacy tuning |
| `drop.max_pitch_deg` | 8 | deg | > 0 | Max \|pitch\| and \|roll\| at release | legacy tuning |
| `drop.max_roll_deg` | 8 | deg | > 0 | Roll limit shown in WAIT_LEVEL messages; the gate itself uses max_pitch_deg for both axes, as legacy did | legacy tuning |
| `drop.tilt_max_relaxed_deg` | 15 | deg | – | Relaxed tilt limit after tilt_relax_after_s of tilt-blocked hovering | legacy tuning |
| `drop.tilt_relax_after_s` | 1.5 | s | > 0 | Tilt-blocked time before relaxing | legacy tuning |
| `drop.cooldown_s` | 2 | s | ≥ 0 | Minimum time between two releases | legacy tuning |

## `control`

Velocity commands and PID gains.

| Key | Default | Unit | Constraints | Description | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `control.takeoff_alt_m` | 3.3 | m | ≥ 3 | Altitude that ends TAKEOFF | rulebook §VI (>= 3.0 m) + margin |
| `control.takeoff_ascent_ms` | 0.8 | m/s | > 0 | Climb rate requested during TAKEOFF | legacy tuning |
| `control.descend_ms` | 0.6 | m/s | > 0 | Descent rate when above the drop window | legacy tuning |
| `control.ascend_ms` | 0.5 | m/s | > 0 | Climb rate when below the drop window | legacy tuning |
| `control.max_speed_ms` | 1 | m/s | > 0 | Horizontal speed limit while targeting | legacy tuning |
| `control.px_to_ms_fire` | 0.005 | m/s per px | > 0 | Fire PID output scale | legacy tuning |
| `control.px_to_ms_helipad` | 0.004 | m/s per px | > 0 | Helipad PID output scale | legacy tuning |
| `control.pid_qualifier` | kp=0.5, ki=0.01, kd=0.15 | - | – | Fire-target PID gains, qualifier round | legacy tuning |
| `control.pid_finals` | kp=0.6, ki=0.02, kd=0.2 | - | – | Fire-target PID gains, finals (moving F2) | legacy tuning |
| `control.pid_helipad` | kp=0.35, ki=0.03, kd=0.1 | - | – | Helipad approach PID gains | legacy tuning |
| `control.pid_output_limit` | 100 | px | > 0 | PID output clamp | legacy tuning |
| `control.smoothing_alpha_qualifier` | 0.4 | - | ≥ 0, < 1 | EMA weight on the OLD target position (0 = no smoothing) | legacy tuning |
| `control.smoothing_alpha_finals` | 0.15 | - | ≥ 0, < 1 | EMA weight on the old position in the finals (less lag on F2) | legacy tuning |

## `feedforward`

Moving-target feedforward (finals F2), disabled while the drone manoeuvres.

| Key | Default | Unit | Constraints | Description | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `feedforward.scale` | 0.003 | m/s per px/s | ≥ 0 | Target pixel velocity -> added drone velocity (finals F2) | legacy tuning |
| `feedforward.max_px_s` | 60 | px/s | > 0 | Clamp on the estimated target velocity | legacy tuning |
| `feedforward.max_add_ms` | 0.4 | m/s | ≥ 0 | Clamp on the added feedforward velocity | legacy tuning |
| `feedforward.cmd_threshold_ms` | 0.35 | m/s | > 0 | Without IMU rates, estimated command speed above which the drone counts as manoeuvring and feedforward is off | legacy tuning |
| `feedforward.angular_rate_gate_dps` | 12 | deg/s | > 0 | IMU pitch/roll rate above which feedforward is off | legacy tuning |
| `feedforward.history_len` | 8 | samples | ≥ 4 | Target position history for the velocity fit | legacy tuning |

## `timing`

Time windows, in seconds of match time rather than frames (ADR-0001).

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `timing.first_step_dt_s` | 0.0333333 | s | > 0 | Time step assumed for the very first step (legacy: 1 / fps_hint) | legacy tuning |
| `timing.no_detect_timeout_s` | 0.33 | s | > 0 | Target lost this long -> RECOVERY / helipad scan | legacy tuning |
| `timing.recovery_timeout_s` | 3 | s | > 0 | Yaw scan length before skipping a target | legacy tuning |
| `timing.scan_step_s` | 0.67 | s | > 0 | Duration of one yaw-scan step | legacy tuning |
| `timing.scan_yaw_steps_dps` | (30, -60, 30, 0) | deg/s | length ≥ 1 | Yaw rate of each scan step (+ = clockwise) | legacy tuning |
| `timing.helipad_scan_exhausted_s` | 9 | s | > 0 | Helipad not seen for longer than this -> blind descent | legacy tuning |
| `timing.land_early_at_s` | 285 | s | > 0 | Match time that forces FIND_HELIPAD | rulebook §XI (300 s) - 15 s margin |
| `timing.helipad_force_land_s` | 5 | s | > 0 | Remaining match time that forces a 1 m/s descent | legacy tuning |
| `timing.geofence_warn_s` | 1 | s | > 0 | Time outside the soft fence before returning | legacy tuning |
